events.title: Beat A Boo! is in Steam Next Fest: Play the Free Demo!
events.summary: Hey boo hunters!Steam Next Fest is here, and Beat A Boo! is part of it! The demo is free to play all week, until October 26. Grab your friends and come play.What is Beat A Boo!?You work for the Devil now. Break into haunted houses with up to 3 friends, smash everything, drive the ghost out of its mind and beat it the only way a ghost can be beaten: with music. events.title: Beat A Boo! Demo v0.5.4 — 9 New Languages for Next Fest
events.summary: Hey boo hunters!Steam Next Fest starts today, and v0.5.4 gets the demo ready for it: Beat A Boo! now speaks 11 languages, and a bunch of the bugs you reported are gone.Highlights9 new languagesOn top of English and Turkish, you can now play in Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil), German, French, Italian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
